title: On OPPO and OnePlus phones the 'Time to train' reminder can arrive with no sound and no banner, and nothing warns the member
what: OPPO and OnePlus phones take the sound and the banner off every new notification kind of an app they do not know. For 'Rest is over' and gym messages the app plays the sound itself to make up for it. The workout reminder is set ahead of time and shows while the app is closed, so the app never gets the chance to do that, and it is left silent in the shade. The reminder row only checks whether notifications are switched off completely, so it still says 'Next: Thu 6:00 pm'.
expected: Either the reminder gets the same rescue sound, or the reminder row and the alert check-up say plainly that on this phone the reminder only shows quietly in the notification list.
who: members on OPPO or OnePlus phones who turned on workout reminders
fix_line: Tell the member on the reminder row when the phone has made the reminder silent, or ring it the same way as the rest alert

title: 'Time to train' stays in the notification list after the member has started or finished the workout
what: Once a workout reminder has shown, nothing ever takes it away: it has no time limit, and starting, finishing or saving a workout only re-plans future reminders. A member who opens the app from the home screen instead of tapping the reminder keeps seeing 'Time to train' after training.
expected: Starting or saving a workout clears a 'Time to train' that is still showing.
fix_line: Clear a showing reminder when a workout starts or is saved

title: A member who turns off 'Reminders from my gym' still looks reached to the owner
what: The member's 'Reminders from my gym' switch is kept only on the phone. When it is off the phone simply drops the gym's plan-ending, birthday and other automatic reminders, and the gym is never told. The owner sees the reminder switched on and has no way to know which members will not get it or why.
expected: The member's choice reaches the gym, and the owner can see per member who will not get the automatic reminders (switched off by the member, notifications off, no app).
how_often: every member who turned it off
fix_line: Send the member's on or off choice to the gym and show it on the member's reach

title: 'Ring through Do Not Disturb' says on, but stays silent when the phone's Do Not Disturb also blocks alarms
what: With 'Ring through Do Not Disturb' on, 'Rest is over' is sent as an alarm, which gets through only because most phones let alarms through Do Not Disturb. If the member's Do Not Disturb is set to block alarms too (total silence, or a phone maker's own mode), the alert and the app's own ring are both held, and neither the switch nor the alert check-up says so.
expected: The check-up tells the member when the phone's Do Not Disturb blocks alarms, so the switch does not promise a ring that cannot come.
who: members who use Do Not Disturb at the gym
how_often: only with alarms blocked in Do Not Disturb
fix_line: Read the phone's Do Not Disturb rules and warn on the check-up when alarms are blocked
